text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Noooo! My destiny was to win! How could my 
sixth sense be wrong?! Still... this will 
be a stepping stone to my next victory!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Next, we're taking a shot at the 1800m 
"Rose S"! Why, you ask? Because European 
mile races have deeper turf, meaning you 
need plenty of stamina to spare!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After the Rose Stakes is the 2000m Shuka 
Sho! And next year, the world! The road 
ahead is set!
